items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. And uh, what was her name? The person you got married to? Uh, Beulah Walker was her name. [INTERVIEWEE] De Beulah Walker? Yeah.

ctx.x: I got hooked up with them. Yeah. Yeah. Mr. Erdogan. I heard that he was looking for me when I was at the Caledonia Inn. Oh really? So, I left the Caledonia Inn and went back to the pebble pot. I thought I was here. Yeah. And he tracked me down and he finally found me, you know. Well, I needed the money bad because I was, my kids was uh... You were married at this time? I wasn't married but I had two kids by the women I'm married to now. Uh huh. See, I didn't really get married until, that was everywhere made on…
Yeah. And uh, what was her name? The person you got married to? Uh, Beulah Walker was her name.
De Beulah Walker? Yeah. Gosh. Wait, let me get this guy. Alright.
